subject: Use when facing a new problem and unsure which problem-solving methodology or foundational skill to apply first.…

evals.prompt: Define problem-approach-router in 2-3 sentences. Include the work it owns and the kind of user request that should activate it.

evals.prompt: A user asks: "I have a completely novel problem nobody has solved before — where do I start?". Show the first concrete steps an agent should take when applying problem-approach-router.
